Title: The Little Brown Bat
Content: The illustration is of a species commonly called the little brown bat. It has `38` teeth and usually lives near bodies of water. The animal is considered beneficial by many people because it eats mosquitoes and many types of garden pests. They feed at night, detecting their prey by echolocation — a form of sonar similar to what is used on ships. They can determine the location and size of their prey by listening to the return echo.
